182: // this returns nil.
183: func LoadDoltDB(ctx context.Context, nbf *types.NomsBinFormat, urlStr string, fs filesys.Filesys) (*DoltDB, error) {

187: func LoadDoltDBWithParams(ctx context.Context, nbf *types.NomsBinFormat, urlStr string, fs filesys.Filesys, params map[string]interface{}) (*DoltDB, error) {
188: 	if params == nil {
189: 		params = make(map[string]any)
190: 	}
191: 
192: 	if urlStr == LocalDirDoltDB {
193: 		exists, isDir := fs.Exists(dbfactory.DoltDataDir)
194: 		if !exists {
195: 			return nil, ErrMissingDoltDataDir
196: 		} else if !isDir {
197: 			return nil, errors.New("file exists where the dolt data directory should be")
198: 		}
199: 
200: 		absPath, err := fs.Abs(dbfactory.DoltDataDir)
201: 		if err != nil {
202: 			return nil, err
203: 		}
204: 
205: 		urlStr = earl.FileUrlFromPath(filepath.ToSlash(absPath), os.PathSeparator)
206: 
207: 		params[dbfactory.ChunkJournalParam] = struct{}{}
208: 	}
209: 
210: 	// Pull the database name out of the URL string. For filesystem-based databases (e.g. in-memory or disk-based
211: 	// filesystem implementations), we can determine the database name by looking at the filesystem path. This
212: 	// won't work for other storage schemes though.
213: 	name := findParentDirectory(urlStr, ".dolt")
214: 
215: 	params[dbfactory.DatabaseNameParam] = name
216: 
217: 	db, vrw, ns, err := dbfactory.CreateDB(ctx, nbf, urlStr, params)
218: 	if err != nil {
219: 		return nil, err
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	commitCache, err := lru.New[hash.Hash, *OptionalCommit](commitCacheSize)
223: 	if err != nil {
224: 		return nil, err
225: 	}

227: 	ret := &DoltDB{
228: 		db:           hooksDatabase{Database: db},
229: 		vrw:          vrw,
230: 		ns:           ns,
231: 		databaseName: name,
232: 		commitCache:  commitCache,
233: 	}
234: 	ret.db.db = ret

279: func (ddb *DoltDB) WriteEmptyRepoWithCommitMetaGeneratorAndDefaultBranch(
280: 	ctx context.Context,
281: 	commitMetaGenerator datas.CommitMetaGenerator,
282: 	init ref.BranchRef,
283: ) error {
284: 	ds, err := ddb.db.GetDataset(ctx, CreationBranch)
285: 
286: 	if err != nil {
287: 		return err
288: 	}
289: 
290: 	if ds.HasHead() {
291: 		return errors.New("database already exists")
292: 	}
293: 
294: 	rv, err := EmptyRootValue(ctx, ddb.vrw, ddb.ns)
295: 
296: 	if err != nil {
297: 		return err
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	rv, _, err = ddb.WriteRootValue(ctx, rv)
301: 
302: 	if err != nil {
303: 		return err
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	var firstCommit *datas.Commit
307: 	for {
308: 		cm, err := commitMetaGenerator.Next()
309: 		if err != nil {
310: 			return err
311: 		}
312: 
313: 		commitOpts := datas.CommitOptions{Meta: cm}
314: 
315: 		cb := ref.NewInternalRef(CreationBranch)
316: 		ds, err = ddb.db.GetDataset(ctx, cb.String())
317: 		if err != nil {
318: 			return err
319: 		}
320: 
321: 		firstCommit, err = ddb.db.BuildNewCommit(ctx, ds, rv.NomsValue(), commitOpts)
322: 		if err != nil {
323: 			return err
324: 		}
325: 
326: 		if commitMetaGenerator.IsGoodCommit(firstCommit) {
327: 			break
328: 		}
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	firstCommitDs, err := ddb.db.WriteCommit(ctx, ds, firstCommit)
332: 
333: 	if err != nil {
334: 		return err
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	ds, err = ddb.db.GetDataset(ctx, init.String())
338: 
339: 	if err != nil {
340: 		return err
341: 	}
342: 
343: 	headAddr, ok := firstCommitDs.MaybeHeadAddr()
344: 	if !ok {
345: 		return errors.New("commit without head")
346: 	}
347: 
348: 	_, err = ddb.db.SetHead(ctx, ds, headAddr, "")
349: 	return err
350: }

404: 		}

429: // findParentDirectory searches the components of the specified |path| looking for a directory
430: // named |targetDir| and returns the name of the parent directory for |targetDir|. The search
431: // starts from the deepest component of |path|, so if |path| contains |targetDir| multiple times,
432: // the parent directory of the last occurrence in |path| is returned.
433: func findParentDirectory(path string, targetDir string) string {
434: 	base := filepath.Base(path)
435: 	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
436: 
437: 	if base == "." || dir == "." {
438: 		return ""
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	switch base {
442: 	case "":
443: 		return base
444: 
445: 	case targetDir:
446: 		return filepath.Base(dir)
447: 
448: 	default:
449: 		return findParentDirectory(dir, targetDir)
450: 	}
451: }

453: // Roots is a convenience struct to package up the three roots that most library functions will need to inspect and

455: // param and return a modified one.
456: //
457: // It contains three root values:

469: func (ddb *DoltDB) getHashFromCommitSpec(ctx context.Context, cs *CommitSpec, cwb ref.DoltRef, nomsRoot hash.Hash) (*hash.Hash, error) {
470: 	switch cs.csType {
471: 	case hashCommitSpec:
472: 		parsedHash, ok := hash.MaybeParse(cs.baseSpec)
473: 		if !ok {
474: 			return nil, errors.New("invalid hash: " + cs.baseSpec)
475: 		}
476: 		return &parsedHash, nil
477: 	case refCommitSpec:
478: 		// For a ref in a CommitSpec, we have the following behavior.
479: 		// If it starts with `refs/`, we look for an exact match before
480: 		// we try any suffix matches. After that, we try a match on the
481: 		// user supplied input, with the following four prefixes, in
482: 		// order: `refs/`, `refs/heads/`, `refs/tags/`, `refs/remotes/`.
483: 		candidates := []string{
484: 			"refs/" + cs.baseSpec,
485: 			"refs/heads/" + cs.baseSpec,
486: 			"refs/tags/" + cs.baseSpec,
487: 			"refs/remotes/" + cs.baseSpec,
488: 		}
489: 		if strings.HasPrefix(cs.baseSpec, "refs/") {
490: 			candidates = []string{
491: 				cs.baseSpec,
492: 				"refs/" + cs.baseSpec,
493: 				"refs/heads/" + cs.baseSpec,
494: 				"refs/tags/" + cs.baseSpec,
495: 				"refs/remotes/" + cs.baseSpec,
496: 			}
497: 		}
498: 		for _, candidate := range candidates {
499: 			var valueHash *hash.Hash
500: 			var err error
501: 			if nomsRoot.IsEmpty() {
502: 				valueHash, err = ddb.GetHashForRefStr(ctx, candidate)
503: 			} else {
504: 				valueHash, err = ddb.GetHashForRefStrByNomsRoot(ctx, candidate, nomsRoot)
505: 			}
506: 			if err == nil {
507: 				return valueHash, nil
508: 			}
509: 			if err != ErrBranchNotFound {
510: 				return nil, err
511: 			}
512: 		}
513: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrBranchNotFound, cs.baseSpec)
514: 	case headCommitSpec:
515: 		if cwb == nil {
516: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot use a nil current working branch with a HEAD commit spec")
517: 		}
518: 		if nomsRoot.IsEmpty() {
519: 			return ddb.GetHashForRefStr(ctx, cwb.String())
520: 		} else {
521: 			return ddb.GetHashForRefStrByNomsRoot(ctx, cwb.String(), nomsRoot)
522: 		}
523: 	default:
524: 		panic("unrecognized commit spec csType: " + cs.csType)
525: 	}
526: }

811: // doWriteRootValue persists |rv| to the database and returns the updated root
812: // value (with its FeatureVersion set) and a Ref to it. If |skipIfPresent| is
813: // true and the root value is already present in the database, the write is
814: // skipped and a Ref to the existing value is returned.
815: //
816: // |skipIfPresent| is used by GC safepoint root collection (see
817: // WorkingSetHashes / DoltSession.VisitGCRoots), where the returned hash is
818: // immediately handed to the GC keeper. There, persisting an already-present
819: // root value is redundant, and--because it dirties the store's memtable--it
820: // defeats the no-op GC fast path (see NomsBlockStore.hasLocalGCNovelty), so
821: // that an online GC of an unchanged database would needlessly rewrite the
822: // store every time. Skipping the write is safe in that path because the caller
823: // keeps the chunk via the keeper whether or not we wrote it. It must NOT be
824: // used on a path that relies on the write being observed by an in-progress GC
825: // (the keeperFunc), since skipping the Put skips that bookkeeping.
826: func (ddb *DoltDB) doWriteRootValue(ctx context.Context, rv RootValue, skipIfPresent bool) (RootValue, types.Ref, error) {
827: 	rv, err := rv.SetFeatureVersion(DoltFeatureVersion)
828: 	if err != nil {
829: 		return nil, types.Ref{}, err
830: 	}
831: 	if skipIfPresent {
832: 		ref, err := types.NewRef(rv.NomsValue(), ddb.db.Format())
833: 		if err != nil {
834: 			return nil, types.Ref{}, err
835: 		}
836: 		existing, err := ddb.vrw.ReadValue(ctx, ref.TargetHash())
837: 		if err != nil {
838: 			return nil, types.Ref{}, err
839: 		}
840: 		if existing != nil {
841: 			return rv, ref, nil
842: 		}
843: 	}
844: 	ref, err := ddb.vrw.WriteValue(ctx, rv.NomsValue())
845: 	if err != nil {
846: 		return nil, types.Ref{}, err
847: 	}
848: 	return rv, ref, nil
849: }

851: // Persists all relevant root values of the WorkingSet to the database and returns all hashes reachable
852: // from the working set. This is used in GC, for example, where all dependencies of the in-memory working
853: // set value need to be accounted for.
854: //
855: // Root values that are already present in the database are not rewritten, so
856: // that collecting the GC roots of an unchanged working set does not dirty the
857: // store and defeat the no-op GC fast path. See doWriteRootValue.
858: func (ddb *DoltDB) WorkingSetHashes(ctx context.Context, ws *WorkingSet) ([]hash.Hash, error) {
859: 	spec, err := ws.writeValues(ctx, ddb, nil, true)
860: 	if err != nil {
861: 		return nil, err
862: 	}
863: 	ret := make([]hash.Hash, 0)
864: 	ret = append(ret, spec.StagedRoot.TargetHash())
865: 	ret = append(ret, spec.WorkingRoot.TargetHash())
866: 	if spec.MergeState != nil {
867: 		fromCommit, err := spec.MergeState.FromCommit(ctx, ddb.vrw)
868: 		if err != nil {
869: 			return nil, err
870: 		}
871: 		h, err := fromCommit.NomsValue().Hash(ddb.db.Format())
872: 		if err != nil {
873: 			return nil, err
874: 		}
875: 		ret = append(ret, h)
876: 		h, err = spec.MergeState.PreMergeWorkingAddr()
877: 		ret = append(ret, h)
878: 	}
879: 	if spec.RebaseState != nil {
880: 		ret = append(ret, spec.RebaseState.PreRebaseWorkingAddr())
881: 		commit, err := spec.RebaseState.OntoCommit(ctx, ddb.vrw)
882: 		if err != nil {
883: 			return nil, err
884: 		}
885: 		h, err := commit.NomsValue().Hash(ddb.db.Format())
886: 		if err != nil {
887: 			return nil, err
888: 		}
889: 		ret = append(ret, h)
890: 	}
891: 	return ret, nil
892: }

95: func (s hooksFiringRemoteSrvStore) Commit(ctx context.Context, current, last hash.Hash) (bool, error) {
96: 	// Snapshot old dataset head addresses before the commit.
97: 	oldDatasets, _ := s.ddb.DatasetsByRootHash(ctx, last)

100: 	if !ok || err != nil {

102: 	}

117: 		})

119: 	newAddrs := make(map[string]hash.Hash)
120: 	_ = newDatasets.IterAll(ctx, func(id string, addr hash.Hash) error {

123: 	})
